notes: Phoenix Facility III is the Louisville, Colorado-addressed project entity for AMP Robotics' grant-backed Solon recycling sortation facility, and AMP is a venture-backed company of a few hundred employees rather than a larger group.
The LLC is the 3PL arm Ray Hamilton Company added in 2022, a Cincinnati moving and logistics business founded in 1892 and still run by the founder's great-great-grandchildren.

Eccrine Systems was an independent venture-backed Cincinnati sweat-sensor startup whose assets were bought by the small Massachusetts firm Epicore Biosystems in May 2022, an asset sale rather than ownership during the grant years.
JobsOhio's 2020 release describes Snowville as a Meigs County creamery founded in 2003 with 30 jobs and quotes its owner, Victoria Taylor, with no parent company named.
SurgiHealth Solutions is a small Cincinnati sterile-processing brush supplier started by local entrepreneur Joshua Williams (Cincinnati Enquirer, 2020), with no parent company found.
